visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Wrap with Modulo
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The head and tail indexes are wrapped by hand with if statements and a magic number 3. Use a SIZE constant and the modulo operator. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: (index + 1) % SIZE is the standard wrap-around idiom, and SIZE appears once instead of three times. The unused size counter is dropped too.
